item.title: SectorC: A C Compiler in 512 bytes
item.description:
📝 Hmm, how about a C that does that. From 468 bytes ⇒ 303 bytes (165 bytes saving): 510 - 303 ⇒ 207 spare bytes to use for new features. Each operator is simply a <16-bit token-value> <16-bit-machine-code> pair, costing just 4 bytes.
🔗 Read more: https://xorvoid.com/sectorc.html

item.title: We mourn our craft
item.description:
📝 Eventually your boss will start asking why you’re getting paid twice your zoomer colleagues’ salary to produce a tenth of the code. It’s maybe not the decision that your younger, more idealistic self would want you to make, but it does keep your car and your house and your family safe inside it. But secretly we’ll miss it.
🔗 Read more: https://nolanlawson.com/2026/02/07/we-mourn-our-craft/
